# whose three boards disagree about how far the overlay reaches. Every reading
# below is off the Plugin API through use_figma - node geometry, gradient

#    the three whose transcript stops short of it (449, 1360-of-1465, and one

#    element. Read gradientTransform with gradientStops, always.

column5: THE SCRIM IS BUILT, AND THE 3-OF-7 WAVE 28 ESCALATED ON TURNS OUT TO BE A RULE. 13008:128603 is 375x189 at y=521 inside a 710-tall main, so its bottom is flush with main's; fill is a linear #001615 gradient whose stops are alpha 0 to 1 but whose gradientTransform is y + 0.3095 - the top edge paints at 0.31 and the fill is solid at 69% of the height, 130px in. What decides which frames carry it was measured on all six 375 frames of this surface rather than voted: the three that draw it are the three whose transcript runs under the composer (13008:128554 ends at 680 against a composer top of 560, and 13008:129637 / 129759 identically), and the three that draw none are the three whose transcript stops short of it - 13008:125688 ends at 449, 13008:129903 at 1360 against a composer top of 1465, and 13008:130217 has no transcript at all. Six of six. It stays phone-only because the wider boards draw no gradient at any length, including 13008:117801, whose transcript overlaps its composer by 100.
